title: CI/CD Pipeline Overhaul
description: Speed up CI, reduce flaky runs, and harden deploy gates by auditing workflows, parallelizing test suites, and migrating critical jobs to self-hosted runners.

phases.title: Audit existing pipeline
phases.description: Map all current GitHub Actions workflows and identify bottlenecks and redundant steps.

tasks.desc: Document all existing .github/workflows/*.yml files and their triggers
Profile average job runtimes over last 30 days using GH Actions API
Identify top 3 slowest steps and propose caching strategy

phases.title: Parallelise test suites
phases.description: Split unit, integration, and e2e tests into parallel matrix jobs to halve overall CI time.

tasks.desc: Rewrite test.yml to use matrix strategy across 4 shards
Add dependency caching for node_modules and Playwright browsers

phases.title: Migrate to self-hosted runners
phases.description: Provision and register self-hosted ARM64 runners on the company's Hetzner fleet.

tasks.desc: Provision two cx21 Hetzner instances with Docker pre-installed
Register runners via GitHub runner registration token
Validate runner isolation — failed due to missing seccomp profile on host kernel
Migrate production deploy job to self-hosted runner

phases.title: Deployment gating and notifications
phases.description: Add required status checks, Slack notifications, and automatic rollback on health-check failure.

tasks.desc: Configure branch protection rules to require passing CI before merge
Add Slack notify step using slackapi/slack-github-action
Implement post-deploy health check with auto-rollback via deploy.yml
